## One-line Positioning

OpenLife is a local-first personal AI Operating Partner that helps users think, plan, act, and remember through a private LifeModel while keeping consequential changes reviewable and auditable.

## Product Capability Preservation Principle

Guardrails prevent hallucination. They must not reduce OpenLife into a generic chat app, todo app, dashboard, settings panel, or knowledge base.

Important product capabilities that are not fully supported today should be marked as `CANDIDATE` or `PHASE_2_REQUIRED`, not removed.

## Aesthetic Positioning

Minimal, calm, high-trust, workspace-centered.
